name: io.github.fengxingxuerong/ai-handoff-kanban
title: AI Handoff Kanban
description: Local-first kanban for people who switch AI coding agents: per-project handoff packs and self-contained takeover pages, AGENTS.md projected to 9 entry files, a 23-tool MCP server (stdio) with incremental context slices, and LLM self-supervision. Windows exe / Docker; all data stays local.
